DTM.Title: Portrait Mask Editor
DTM.MenuHint: Frame a circular crop for a shared token portrait.
DTM.Help: Drag the center dot to move the circle. Drag the right dot to resize it.
DTM.Source: Source image with circle and drag handles
DTM.Shared: Saving or removing a mask changes every eligible token using this exact image path in this world.
DTM.Permission: The editor is available to GMs once the world is ready.
DTM.InvalidSource: Enter a specific image path or select an image with the file picker. Wildcard paths are unsupported.
DTM.Unsupported: Select a static PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
DTM.LoadFailed: Could not open the image. Verify the path and that this world can read the image, then try again.
DTM.ReadFailed: Could not read saved masks. Reload the world page before trying again.
DTM.DimensionsChanged: The image dimensions have changed. Review the circle and save it again to update the token crop.
DTM.Conflict: The saved mask changed. Load this image again before saving or removing it.
DTM.SaveFailed: Could not save the mask. Check your connection and GM access, then try again.
DTM.RemoveFailed: Could not remove the mask. Check your connection and GM access, then try again.
